products.title: 3D Collider
products.shortDescription: Generate practical colliders for complex 3D meshes directly inside the Unity Editor.
products.description: 3D Collider is a Unity Editor tool for generating colliders from complex meshes. In non-convex mode it creates surface-based MeshCollider geometry that can preserve openings, holes, tunnels and passages. In Convex mode it creates closed convex MeshColliders generated from the model surface for Rigidbody workflows.
features: Surface-based MeshCollider generation for static geometry
Preserves important openings, holes, tunnels and passages
Closed convex MeshColliders generated from the model surface for Rigidbody workflows
Adjustable Accuracy with real-time Editor preview

products.title: Bronchoscopy
products.shortDescription: Interactive bronchoscopy simulator for practicing navigation, controls, and essential endoscopic skills.

sitePages.title: Bronchoscopy
sitePages.heading: Bronchoscopy
sitePages.content:
Bronchoscopy is an interactive simulator designed for practicing bronchoscope navigation and basic endoscopic skills in a virtual environment.
Explore the airways, learn to control the bronchoscope, and become familiar with navigation through the bronchial tree using simple and intuitive controls.
The simulator is designed as a practical training and demonstration tool. Future versions may expand the experience with additional procedures, training scenarios, and new interactive features.
Bronchoscopy is intended for educational and simulation purposes only and is not a medical device.

blocks.heading: Installation on Android
blocks.content:
To install the APK, Android may ask you to allow installation from unknown sources.
Download the APK file.
Open the downloaded file.
If Android blocks the installation, open Settings when prompted.
Enable Allow from this source for the browser or file manager you used to open the APK.
Return to the installer and continue the installation.
After installation, you can disable this permission again if you prefer.
The wording and location of this setting may vary depending on the Android version and device manufacturer.
